app.settings.block_physical_clicks_help: When enabled, physical clicks and click-drag from selected trackpads are blocked. Tap-to-click remains blocked while the keypad is active.
app.settings.center_region_size_help: 100% is the original size. Increasing this expands both the entry and exit boundaries.
app.ui.a_stronger_haptic_marks_the_small: A stronger haptic marks the small center region.
app.ui.allow_accessibility_access_then_t: Allow Accessibility access, then turn the keypad on again.
app.ui.allow_numpad_in_system_settings_g: Allow Numpad in System Settings → General → Login Items to finish enabling launch at login.
app.ui.calibration_is_saved_separately_f: Calibration is saved separately for each trackpad and key arrangement. Turn calibration off to use the uncalibrated layout.
app.ui.changes_are_saved_automatically_o: Changes are saved automatically. Opening Settings turns off the keypad.
app.ui.choose_a_keyboard_shortcut_to_tog: Choose a keyboard shortcut to toggle the keypad on and off.
app.ui.choose_a_side_for_backspace_divid: Choose a side for ⌫ ÷ × − + ↵. You can change it in Settings anytime.
app.ui.click_and_drag_the_overlay_to_sav: Click and drag the overlay to save its position. It moves out of the way when it would cover the focused input field.
app.ui.could_not_load_the_multitouchsupp: Could not load the MultitouchSupport framework.
app.ui.could_not_start_input_monitoring_: Could not start input monitoring. Check Accessibility access and restart Numpad.
app.ui.could_not_start_receiving_trackpa: Could not start receiving trackpad touches. Check the connection and restart Numpad.
app.ui.could_not_update_launch_at_login: Could not update launch at login.
app.ui.count_finger_calibration_applied_: %d-finger calibration applied · Position, rotation, and scale
app.ui.defaults_to_on_touch_drag_with_th: Defaults to On Touch. Drag with three or four fingers to move, rotate, and scale the layout live. macOS drag, zoom, and desktop-switching gestures are blocked during calibration.
Defaults to On Touch. Drag with three or four fingers to move, rotate, and scale the layout live. Only events identified as coming from selected trackpads are blocked.
app.ui.events_whose_source_device_cannot: Events whose source device cannot be identified pass through unchanged.
app.ui.got_it_you_can_now_turn_on_the_ke: Got it! You can now turn on the keypad in any app.
app.ui.include_command_option_or_control: Include Command, Option, or Control and a non-modifier key. Esc is reserved.
app.ui.input_monitoring_stopped_so_the_k: Input monitoring stopped, so the keypad was turned off. Turn it on again to continue.
app.ui.keep_the_last_calibration_when_tu: Keep the last calibration when turning the keypad back on. Turn this off to start each session with the default layout. Applies to the next session.
app.ui.keypad_active_press_esc_to_exit: Keypad active · Press Esc to exit
app.ui.keypad_off_use_your_trackpad_as_u: Keypad off. Use your trackpad as usual.
app.ui.lives_in_your_menu_bar_one_shortc:
Lives in your menu bar. One shortcut turns your trackpad
into a numeric keypad, right at your fingertips.
app.ui.macos_shortcuts_and_registered_gl: macOS shortcuts and registered global shortcuts are checked. Some app-specific shortcuts and modifier-only shortcuts cannot be checked.
app.ui.move_your_fingers_a_little_farthe: Move your fingers a little farther apart.
app.ui.new_trackpads_stay_off_until_sele: New trackpads stay off until selected. A connection change turns the keypad off safely; press the shortcut to resume. Selection is remembered for recognized devices.
app.ui.no_trackpad_found_connect_a_track: No trackpad found. Connect a trackpad and try again.
app.ui.numpad_controls_pointer_input_and: Numpad controls pointer input and sends numeric keypad events to the focused app while keypad mode is active.
app.ui.numpad_is_ready_in_your_menu_bar_: Numpad is ready in your menu bar. Focus an input field and press the shortcut to start typing numbers.
app.ui.numpad_needs_permission_to_hold_t: Numpad needs permission to hold the pointer still and send numbers to the app you are using. It does not read or save your input.
app.ui.open_the_installed_numpad_app_to_: Open the installed Numpad app to configure launch at login.
app.ui.place_four_fingers_together_the_m: Place four fingers together. The middle two align with × and − from left to right, adjusting position, rotation, and scale to match their key centers.
app.ui.press_a_key_with_command_option_o: Press a key with Command, Option, or Control. Esc cancels.
app.ui.press_and_release_your_shortcut_u: Press and release your shortcut. Use two modifier keys, or a key with Command, Option, or Control. Esc cancels.
app.ui.press_command_command_and_option_: Press Command ⌘ and Option ⌥ together on the right of the space bar.
app.ui.press_esc_to_skip_this_step: Press Esc to skip this step
app.ui.rest_one_finger_to_use_it_as_an_a: Rest one finger to use it as an anchor
app.ui.right_command_right_option_to_tog: Right ⌘ + Right ⌥ to toggle · Esc to exit
app.ui.select_a_trackpad_in_settings_bef: Select a trackpad in Settings before turning on the keypad.
app.ui.select_two_keys_to_swap_them_slot: Select two keys to swap them. Slot sizes stay fixed. Each side remembers its own arrangement.
app.ui.start_numpad_in_the_menu_bar_when: Start Numpad in the menu bar when you log in. The keypad stays off until you activate it.
app.ui.tap_briefly_with_one_finger_to_en: Tap briefly with one finger to enter %@. Practice stays in this guide and never types into another app.
app.ui.the_activation_shortcut_toggles_o: The activation shortcut toggles only the selected trackpads. Other trackpads keep their normal pointer, clicks, scrolling, and gestures.
app.ui.the_keypad_is_paused_while_secure: The keypad is paused while Secure Input is active.
app.ui.the_latest_calibration_applies_to: The latest calibration applies to the entire layout and is saved separately for each operator position. Turn calibration off to return to the default layout.
app.ui.the_required_trackpad_api_is_unav: The required trackpad API is unavailable on this version of macOS.
app.ui.this_shortcut_is_assigned_in_maco: This shortcut is assigned in macOS Keyboard Shortcuts. Choose another combination.
app.ui.this_shortcut_is_unavailable_or_r: This shortcut is unavailable or registered by another app. Choose another combination.
app.ui.those_are_the_left_keys_try_the_r: Those are the left keys. Try the right ⌘ and ⌥ keys.
app.ui.trackpad_connections_changed_chec: Trackpad connections changed. Check your devices and turn the keypad on again.
app.ui.try_tapping_again_within_the_trac: Try tapping again within the trackpad.
app.ui.turn_the_keypad_on_again_after_le: Turn the keypad on again after leaving Secure Input.
app.ui.turn_your_trackpad_into_a_numeric: Turn your trackpad into a numeric keypad.
app.ui.update_settings_help: Numpad checks periodically. Updates download in the background and install automatically when Numpad is not running.
app.ui.use_the_same_shortcut_or_press_es: Use the same shortcut or press Esc to turn the keypad off.
app.ui.use_the_shortcut_to_toggle_your_s: Use the shortcut to toggle your selected trackpads. Esc always turns the keypad off.
app.ui.use_two_modifier_keys_or_a_key_wi: Use two modifier keys, or a key with Command, Option, or Control. Esc cancels.
app.ui.using_the_default_layout_calibrat: Using the default layout. Calibrate again if needed.
app.ui.when_a_tap_is_confirmed_on_releas: When a tap is confirmed on release
app.ui.when_enabled_the_overlay_appears_: When enabled, the overlay appears on every connected display. Only the primary overlay can be dragged.
app.ui.with_the_keypad_on_place_three_fi: With the keypad on, place three fingers together. Keep the middle finger at the center of 5 and use the outer fingers to adjust rotation and scale. Key shapes and proportions stay the same.
app.ui.you_will_return_here_once_access_: You will return here once access is granted
